original_source: existing exposed DEV; no new physical source actions; not sealed science
context: literal mission + direction + observed front pixel [object,color,state]
chronology: evaluate BEFORE own selected consequence; group by source role and family; carry state across 3 historical chronological DEV seeds only
exact_change: public before/after SHA256 difference including heading/camera changes, not necessarily objective progress
native_rule: For each hypothetical parent action p, require another action a!=p with >=3 prior same-context own-selected samples, score(a)=floor(10000*(changed+1)/(count+2)) >=7500 and >= score(p)+1000; evaluate all seven possible parent actions as an OPTIMISTIC upper bound; preserve integer semantics
reward_cut: Count predecision eligible points strictly before first genuine positive reward for that role/family; separately all-time
metrics: eligible alternative action types vs turns
exact source identity and two-process parity
negative_control: Count turn-actions 0 and 1 separately; NEVER call raw image change a goal, movement, novelty or true causal improvement
fail_closed: event-set or per-event original public hash mismatch
interpretation: Zero eligible means this older on-policy MG19 source never enables the MG28 nonreward rule as an optimistic all-parent upper bound. Nonzero eligible means possible historical override support ONLY, not an actual MG28 choice, native return improvement or causal transfer.
source_owner_authority: NO new original world reset/step, native model integration, FSA first-use or controller execution authorized
